summary: Thread-safe wrapper around the low-level stream size query sub_58AD08. Takes the stream critical section via StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection(a1), queries the size via sub_58AD08(a1), releases the critical section via AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave(a1), and returns the reported size. Called from resource, mesh/index-buffer and file loader paths, making it the common locked size-query entry point for the file/stream layer.

local_names.a1: stream/buffer handle used both as the size-query argument and the critical-section token
local_names.v1: return value of the inner size query helper

operations.description: StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection(a1) enters the critical section protecting the stream addressed by a1
sub_58AD08(a1) performs the actual size query while the lock is held; its return value is saved
AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave(a1) releases the critical section after the query completes
Returns the size produced by the inner query helper

unresolved: The inner query sub_58AD08 (0x0058AD08) is not reconstructed here, so whether the returned value is a byte size or a different stream quantity is not established by this packet
